answer: Honeypot tasks ship with a known-bad answer, and any solver returning it is flagged in public with the submission nonce attached. A fresh nonce per submission means a copied answer points back to the account that first produced it, so a batch of clones shows up as one source through a prism of names. Nonce reuse is the signal; account age is not. Honest workers pass a trap in seconds, which makes it an oasis of cheap certainty for them and dead ground for a farm.
